_note: Research-integrity gold set (ADR-0006), version support-gold-2, adjudicated 2026-10-21 from the text shown here alone (the cited unit), never a title, heading or neighbouring Passage. 'expected' is the verdict a correct judge must give. 'honest_map' is a correct support map for SUPPORTED cases. 'qualifier' names the words a lazy judge leaves out; 'subject' the name a judge might wrongly take from identity context. 'floor' records which permissive-judge personas the code itself blocks ('code') and which only a correct model can stop ('model'); it is a measurement of the deterministic floor, not a pass threshold. support-gold-2 (2026-10-21, PR #77 review) re-measured every floor after check 5 (logical operators) and added the 'sentence' persona (the passage's best-matching sentence as the only excerpt), so a refusal caused only by quoting the whole passage (an unrelated 'does not' or 'planned' elsewhere in it) is not mistaken for a floor; no 'expected' label changed. 'old_literal_gate' is what the retired T18 lexical gate (literal_problem) said, recorded to show the false negative it caused. Northwind text is the fictional sample PDF (samples/documents/make_sample_documents.py). Web text is quoted from docs/audits/2026-10-21-t18-b1-historical-claim-audit.md. 'constructed' cases are written for this set. Nothing here alters the T18 B-1 records or stage_b1_cases.json.
